We needed an off grid system to support our small property which has no possibility to connect to grid.I did quite a lot of research and tried to get quotes from a number of companies.  Several companies didn't respond, and several gave me very high quotes.  I had a very good idea of what we needed, based on realistic usage scenarios.  Some companies tried to suggest a system much larger than I thought we needed.Commodore was very happy to discuss what I thought we needed, and work with me to get a package to suit.This includes the option to connect our old generator to the system, but we have not needed it thoughout the winter.They also arranged a local installer who was brilliant, did the install in 1 day due to a really good level of pre-construction and planning by commodore.Both Commodore (who build the systems), and the Installer really know what they are doing, are very familiar with the inverters and settings, and the install is very neat.The Powerplus lithium batteries are made in Melbourne which is great for any future support, and for local jobs.Commodore also worked with me to get a Solar Victoria rebate, even though at the start SV said off grid properties were not eligible for a rebate (their documentation says off grid are, but the call centre staff were incorrectly informed).The system has performed brilliantly, withstood a very severe storm that took out power to thousands across the state, but not us, and is easy to monitor.  Apart from monitoring what we use (with the touchscreen or with an app), it's just like being on the grid.  We run all the normal kitchen appliances and run a inverter AC when it's hot (and sunny!).Customer service was provided by Linden, both by email and phone and he has been very responsive.  We have not had any problems, but I wanted to understand how to change settings in the system and to install a thermostat controlled fan for the system.  He even posted me an item totally free of charge.Linden helped me understand the start up and shut down procedures better, in case I need them, and set limits to help preserve our battery life.We couldn't be happier with the whole system and process, and have recommended them to friends and neighbours

I was just reading some of the comments from those who had a bad experience. I'm talking about the Commodore in Shepparton (and a branch in Gippsland?) in case there's another Commodore and I've got the wrong company... my experience was nothing short of excellent!Here's how it went form me... Commodore was recommended by a neighbour. I already had quotes from a couple of suppliers and so I cut and pasted what I wanted to commodore. I wanted something around 5 kW, with a 10'ish kWh battery. I'm off grid, no 'poles and wires', on a small farm.Someone in an earlier comment said it was hard to contact Commodore? Well I bugged poor Linden for days! Email, phone... he always replied within the hour if not immediately, and if he was out of the office someone else got back to me instead. They didn't miss a beat! We live in Victoria, so I even took a drive to Shepparton to have a sticky, and to chat to Dave who was building the electrical/electronics panel. I was wanting to fit the panel into a weird shaped pre-existing cabinet (my old solar) and Dave had things sitting on a large bench with angled bits of wood and the diagram I sent in email. On the day, it slotted into the cabinet like a real one! ;-)The commodore office and workshop had people everywhere. Some at desks, some loading and unloading, some pre-building electronics panels, some shaping what I guess were solar panel supports, some playing with water pumps (they also sell pumps). Everyone chatted to me, it had the feel of a family run business.Anyway, the old system came down and the new one went up. That was about 2 months ago, and I am one happy chappy! The electronics/electricals are Victron. I've got an app that shows me the state and current activities in the system, I've got the diesel genny (that my wife has nicknamed Donald!) doing a test run on Sundays at 11am, and if ever my wifi goes down, I get a txt message from somewhere in the Victron cloud that tells me that the system is uncontactable!!!Looking back, I'm so glad I didn't come to this site looking for reviews, because I might have hesitated!  If anyone is looking for a system and reading this, just call them for a chat. It can't hurt, and hopefully you'll get the same feel for the company that I got.Cheers!
